description: Search the semantic_memory table for prior incidents similar to the current context using CockroachDB's distributed vector index (KNN over VECTOR(1024) embeddings). Accepts either a raw embedding vector or a natural-language text query that is embedded on-the-fly via Bedrock Titan Text v2. Returns matches ranked by L2 distance (closest first) with similarity scores.

query_text.description: Natural-language description of the current incident context (e.g. 'OpenSSL critical CVE on internet-facing production kubernetes workload'). Exactly one of query_text or query_vector must be provided. When query_text is given, the Lambda embeds it via Bedrock Titan Text v2 before searching.

query_vector.description: Pre-computed 1024-dimensional float embedding vector. Use this when the caller has already generated an embedding. Exactly one of query_text or query_vector must be provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of similar incidents to return (1–10). Defaults to 3.

filters.description: Optional flat key/value constraints applied to the incident_jsonb column before vector ranking. Keys are JSONB field names (e.g. 'cve_id', 'severity', 'exposure'). Only rows whose incident_jsonb contains matching values are searched.
